applies_why: The judge text compares the challenger's chain and the defender's chain in a collision, so it is doing the chain-against-chain weighing K-C governs.
quote: the challenger's seed/loins chain is footed but does not name Joseph as the begetter
rule_words: the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires
room: never verse by verse; one reading bars any explicit-naming deficiency as verse-by-verse weighing, the other bars only a demand that a verse state the contrary in its own words.
why: The judge marks the challenger's chain deficient because it does not name Joseph, so it uses an explicit-naming/word-for-word test after noting the chain is footed.
